VENDOR VERIFICATION

How to Verify a Tutor Is an Approved ESA Vendor

Before you book a tutor with ESA funds, here's exactly how to confirm they're legitimately approved in your state — not just claiming to be.

Avoid Funding Delays State-by-State Verification 5-Minute Check
Quick Summary

All Inclusive Tutoring Solutions LLC helps families verify approved ESA vendor status before booking tutoring services in any of 12 states.

Why Verification Matters

Not every tutor who says "I accept ESA funds" is actually registered as an approved vendor in your state's system. Booking with an unverified provider can mean payment delays, denied reimbursements, or funds that simply can't be processed. A quick check before booking saves that headache entirely.

How to Check, State by State

  • ClassWallet states (AZ, FL, NC, SC): search the provider directly in your ClassWallet marketplace
  • Odyssey states (LA, UT, IA, WY): use the Odyssey provider search tool
  • Ask directly for their vendor ID or registration confirmation number
  • Cross-check against your state's official published provider list
  • When in doubt, call your program administrator directly to confirm

What a Legitimately Approved Vendor Can Show You

A genuinely approved vendor should be able to point you to their listing in your state's official system (not just a screenshot or a claim), explain exactly how they bill through your platform, and answer specific questions about your state's application process without hesitation.
